name: The World As It Was
source:
You’ve woken up in someone else’s skin and he’s been waiting for you. Spend a quiet, easy day with Arcturus. Together, walk through a day in his life and speak to the lovely cast that will eventually become your closest companions! 

[From [url=https://thereseu3u.itch.io/the-world-as-it-was]itch.io[/url]]
